understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving/selecting the available pieces so that every goal tile marked with '+' in the semantic grid is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, triggering a WIN for the level; clearing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses MOVE_* actions to shift the currently selected selectable piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction, using pixel coordinates like [x,y] shown in state/objects. Walls (#) and boundaries can block movement, and some objects (blocks/B) are pushable: if the selected piece moves into an adjacent pushable in the movement direction, the block may be pushed along (if space allows). Levels can have multiple selectables; CLICK with a target_position matching a selectable’s pixel position switches control to that piece. The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not guarantee the move will fail.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving/selecting the available pieces so that every goal tile marked with '+' in the semantic grid is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, triggering a WIN for the level; clearing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses MOVE_* actions to shift the currently selected selectable piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction, using pixel coordinates like [x,y] shown in state/objects. Walls (#) and boundaries can block movement, and some objects (blocks/B) are pushable: if the selected piece moves into an adjacent pushable in the movement direction, the block may be pushed along (if space allows). Levels can have multiple selectables; CLICK with a target_position matching a selectable’s pixel position switches control to that piece. The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not guarantee the move will fail.
